snippet.title: Withdrawal | Official Demo Build Trailer
snippet.description:
itch link: https://arijxn.itch.io/withdrawal

Withdrawal
A roguelike fast paced FPS. You play as Mr. (?) Norton on his way to kill all the people in the tower of Cranterry Wealth Corp. Your task, as mentioned, is to kill the CEO of the company Maxwell Adams.

The game contains violent gore as well as procedurally generated levels, increasing the replayability and randomness.

========
[CHAOS]

Now with better gore, and more weapons, there's more chaos!

Try to clear the whole floor before securing yourself at the elevator. Could be useful!

Floors are procedurally generated for the best gameplay. You never know what's waiting.

========
[DEALER]

We've got a new friend, the Dealer! Dealer's purpose is to sell you new weapons and percs that could be useful for the next run. Try to secure as much money as you can on every floor.

========
T R U S T  T H E  D E A L E R
========
